user.title: Brave Search API
user.description: Optional: paste a Brave Search API key to let the assistant look things up on the web. Leave it empty to use only the local answers (spelling, maths, units, dates, world clock); you can add a key later with Reconfigure. Checking the key uses 1 search from your Brave credit.

data_description.api_key: From api-dashboard.search.brave.com. Only the question text is ever sent.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new key, or leave it empty to turn web search off. Checking a new key uses 1 search from your Brave credit.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Brave Search API.

abort.already_configured: Already set up. Use Configure to change settings.

data.web_search: Look things up on the web
data.speak_source: Say which site the answer came from

data_description.monthly_cap: Searches stop for the rest of the month at this number. Shown on the 'Searches this month' sensor.

data.compound_commands: Run compound commands ("turn off the lamp and play the news")
data.max_compound_parts: Most parts in one compound command

data_description.question_guard: A misheard statement gets "Sorry, I didn't catch that." instead of spending a search.

data_description.snooze_minutes: Used for "snooze". You can also say "set the snooze to 10 minutes".
data_description.snooze_limit: Leave empty for no limit, or 1-10. 0 turns snoozing off. By voice: "limit snoozes to 3", "no snooze limit", "no snoozing".
data_description.snooze_enabled: Off: the alarm rings until you stop it.
